label: TP
reason: Alert 1 (java/insecure-randomness): alert-TP — resolved sink value rememberMeKey = Integer.toString(new java.util.Random().nextInt(99)) at L101-L102; java.util.Random is cryptographically insecure and the generated random number is directly stored in the session attribute and cookie, enabling session fixation attacks. Alert 2 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value includes user-provided cookie value (from URL-decoded request cookie) concatenated into HTML response at L110-L115 without sanitization. Both alerts represent real vulnerabilities.

evidence.note: Insecure randomness: rememberMeKey assigned from new java.util.Random().nextInt(99)
XSS: User-provided cookie value concatenated into response writer println without encoding
